slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
东玄域，灵洲。
太煌圣地。
此刻正值深夜。
房间中，苏灵鸢从修炼中醒来，睁开了一双灵动的眸子。
她惬意的伸了个懒腰，口中发出哼哼唧唧的声音。
其姣好的身段展露，勾勒出优美的玲珑曲线，胸前的丰盈硕果亦随着她的动作而起伏。
“咦，这是什么？”
苏灵鸢眼神随意扫视，这才发现了自己身旁静悄悄躺着的一本黑金色本子。
她伸手拿起，扫过封面。
“楚歌日记本——苏灵鸢副本。”
“怪哉，这日记本是怎么放到我这的？楚歌又是谁，这上面，为什么会有我的名字？”
她这专属的修炼室，设有极为高明的阵法。
未经过她本人允许，想要悄无声息不触发阵法进入其内，至少也得是大能级别的人物或者是阵法一道的宗师才能做到。
而即便是这等人物，想要做到也得花费一番功夫。
大费周折就为了给她送这么个日记本，显然是说不通的。
“哼！我倒要看看，是谁在搞鬼。”
轻哼一声，苏灵鸢翻开日记本，开始阅览其中信息。
【九月九日，天气，晴，今天是我穿越的第十八年，也是我觉醒金手指的第一天。】
苏灵鸢眉头轻蹙。
“穿越？金手指？这是何意？”

好似感受到了她心中疑惑，下一刻，一道讯息传入苏灵鸢脑海。
“竟...竟然是这等神奇事物吗？”
了解了穿越与金手指为何物的苏灵鸢顿时大惊！
她继续往下看。
【我觉醒了反派写日记打卡签到系统，怎么说呢，这系统，给我一种缝合怪的既视感........】
【但是......系统，你缝的好啊！’】
苏灵鸢继续提取信息中的关键字眼，这回她懵了。
反派，写日记，打卡，签到，这些个字她倒是都认识，但组合在一起就......
不过很快，又有讯息传入脑海，苏灵鸢立刻便了解了这些字眼的含义。
“什么？！！”
“意思是这个名为楚歌的日记本主人，每天什么事都可以不做，不用打坐修炼，不用吞吐天地灵气，只需要随手写写日记，去到某些特殊地方，就能获得奇珍异宝，上涨修为？”
苏灵鸢声音都变了，再也没办法淡定。
“这世间怎么会有这种东西？！！”
“可恶啊！为什么我没有？！”
她小拳头攥的紧紧的，脸上流露出愤慨的表情。
出身大族，自小拜入圣地，成为圣地之主亲传弟子的她，从来都是别人羡慕的对象。
content_en:
Dongxuan Territory, Lingzhou.
Taihuang Holy Land.
It was late at night.
In the room, Su Lingyuan woke up from practicing and opened a pair of smart eyes.
She stretched out comfortably and made a humming sound.
Her beautiful figure is exposed, outlining graceful and exquisite curves, and the plump breasts rise and fall with her movements.
"Hey, what is this?"
Su Lingyuan glanced around casually, and then she discovered a black and gold book lying quietly next to her.
She reached for it and scanned the cover.
"Chu Ge's Diary—Su Lingyuan's copy."
"That's strange. How did you put this diary here? Who is Chu Ge? Why is my name on it?"
Her exclusive training room is equipped with extremely advanced formations.
Without her permission, if you want to enter it quietly without triggering the formation, you must at least be a powerful person or a master of the formation.
And even for such a person, it takes a lot of effort to achieve it.
It obviously didn't make sense to go to such great lengths just to give her such a diary.
"Hmph! I want to see who is doing this."
With a soft hum, Su Lingyuan opened the diary and began to read the information.
[September 9th, the weather is sunny. Today is the eighteenth year of my time travel, and it is also the first day that I awakened my golden finger. 】
Su Lingyuan frowned slightly.
"Time travel? Goldfinger? What does this mean?"
As if he felt the doubts in her heart, the next moment, a message came into Su Lingyuan's mind.
"Is it...that it's such a magical thing?"
Su Lingyuan was shocked when she understood what time travel and golden fingers were!
She continued to look down.
[I awakened the villain’s diary and check-in system. How should I put it, this system gave me a sense of deja vu as a stitch monster...]
[But... System, you are good at sewing! ’]
Su Lingyuan continued to extract key words from the information, but this time she was confused.
Villain, writing diary, clocking in, signing in, she knew all these words, but when combined together...
But soon, another message came into his mind, and Su Lingyuan immediately understood the meaning of these words.
"What?!!"
"It means that the owner of the diary named Chu Ge doesn't have to do anything every day. He doesn't need to meditate and practice or breathe in the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. He only needs to write a diary casually. When he goes to certain special places, he can obtain rare treasures and increase his cultivation level?"
Su Lingyuan's voice changed and she could no longer remain calm.
“How can such a thing exist in this world?!”
"Damn it! Why didn't I?!"
Her little fists were clenched tightly, with an expression of indignation on her face.
She came from a wealthy family, worshiped in the Holy Land since she was a child, and became the direct disciple of the Lord of the Holy Land. She has always been the envy of others.
